title: The Wrong Defender
setup: Black has defended the e5 pawn with the f-pawn instead of a piece. Punish it by offering material that opens the diagonal to Black's king.
hint: Ask what road opens if that new defender is forced to capture, and which white piece is waiting at the end of it.
explanation:
## The Idea

Defending e5 with the f-pawn holds the pawn, but it opens the diagonal from h5 to the black king.

{{Nxe5}} offers a piece to use it. If {{fxe5}}, then {{Qh5+}}: blocking on g6 loses the h8 rook after {{Qxe5+}} and the queen's next capture, and stepping to e7 lets the queen hunt the king in the open. Declining with {{Qe7}} wins the pawn back, but leaves Black's king and development clearly worse.

Defend with pieces first. A pawn that has moved cannot come back.
